question: In which of the following places is the cellulose of food digested by the action of certain bacteria in animals like horses, rabbit, etc.?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Caecum**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **cellulose of food is digested in the caecum **of animals like horses and rabbits by the action of certain bacteria.
 
• It is Located **between the oesophagus and the small intestine**
 
• Cellulose is digested by symbiotic bacteria and protozoans through a slow decomposition process.
 
• Cellulose is a **complex organic compound that is a primary component of plant cell walls.**
 
• It is indigestible by **many animals, including humans, because it doesn't dissolve in water or other solvents. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/65d6135230e0d590aee5ea51141469ecdc465fdb6cc9051192a6ae4cb6a37dd4.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Oesophagus:**

 
 
• **The oesophagus is a muscular tube that **connects the throat (pharynx) to the stomach.
 
• **Its **primary function is to transport swallowed food and liquids **from the mouth to the stomach through a series of coordinated muscle contractions known as peristalsis.**
 
• It lies behind the trachea and extends from the pharynx to the stomach.
 
 
 
• **Stomach:**
 
 
• **​**The stomach is a** hollow, muscular organ that plays a key role in digesting food.**
 
• It secretes digestive enzymes and acids to break down food.
 
• The stomach also churns food to mix it with gastric juices, **creating a substance called chyme.**
 
• It is **located between the oesophagus and the small intestine.**
 
 
 
• **Small Intestine:**
 
 
• **​**The small intestine is **responsible for the majority of digestion and nutrient absorption.**
 
• It **consists of three parts: the duodenum, jejunum, and ileum.**
 
• In the small intestine, food is mixed with bile (from the liver) and pancreatic juices (from the pancreas), breaking down fats, proteins, and carbohydrates into absorbable nutrients.
 
• It is **located between the stomach and the large intestine.**
